senses: A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.17.1
the great prophet of the reign of Ahab
a son of Elam with foreign wife during exile
a son of Harim, and priest, with foreign wife during exile

strongs.def: Elijah, the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites
strongs.from: or prolonged אֵלִיָּהוּ; from H410 (אֵל) and H3050 (יָהּ); God of Jehovah
